Class TurnManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.gameTurnManager.TurnManager
public class TurnManager extends Object
Manages the flow of the game, including player turn order, round tracking, and coordinating state transitions between different game phases.

      public void setPhase(Phase phase)
      Sets the current phase of the game. This method should be used to change the phase of the game, and it should be called by the phases themselves when they want to move to the next phase.

      phase - The new Phase to set.
